replay.compare: per case: each step's outcome in step order (a send's `returned` = the reply, `threw` = Node's error as its caller got it, which the core's domain error must equal once the desktop's coreFailure (apps/desktop/src/shared/core-error.ts) turns it into an error: message, code, and details = the detail's fields without the wire's type tag; `stopped` = what the stop returned; `restarted`/`released` mark the step), the log rows read back (DirectoryRoomDaemon::room_rows), the routed requests in Node's option shape ({ roomId, to, everyone, waiting }) as the scheduler took them (RoomCalls::route), the room fields after the last step (lastSpeaker, lastAt, lastPreview, submissions), the catalog republish count, and for the files case the stored bytes of each part

normalised.newId: a row id the room makes (`user_` + newId(), agent-rooms.ts:183: the time in base 36 and four random bytes, each one new) is recorded as `user_newId1`, `user_newId2`, ... in the order the room made them; the replay renames the core's read-back row ids that start with `user_` and are no submission id of the case, in the order they first appear, to the same names, and nothing else
